scientific.integrity: The proof combines the exact first-step LAMB direction, a self-contained sharp SPD turning-angle inequality, and a two-dimensional coordinate-saturation lemma. Sharpness is supplied by an explicit rotated endpoint-spectrum family and continuity in the curvature scale.
limitations: The theorem is two-dimensional and first-step.
It concerns Euclidean distance rather than objective monotonicity.
The sharpness family may require large absolute curvature relative to epsilon while preserving condition number.
Later moment history and stochasticity are outside the claim.

title: Sharp conditioning threshold for an obtuse first LAMB direction
